name: Overload Primal Herb
tooltip:
Overload Primal Herb
5 yd range
5.3 sec cast
Primal herbs hold a deep-rooted connection with Azeroth through which a skilled herbalist can commune with the land. By overloading this type of herb, you channel your health into the land, gaining Motes of Primal Energy based on how much you offer in exchange.

Discovery: Midnight Gathering Nodes
